name: Ukugonywa kwezingane
tagline: Uhlelo lwamahhala lwe-SA. Konke ukudubula kubalulekile.

what_is_it.heading: Ukugonywa kwezingane ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Imithi yokugoma iqeqesha amasosha omzimba wengane ukuthi alwe nezifo ngaphambi kokuba ahlangane nazo empilweni yangempela. Uhlelo Olunwetshiwe LwaseNingizimu Afrika Lokugomela (i-EPI-SA) luvikela ezifweni ezibulala kakhulu izingane - konke kumahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni.
paragraphs: Umuthi wokugoma ufundisa umzimba ukubona igciwane noma amagciwane ngokuwubonisa inguqulo engenangozi. Lapho kufika into yangempela, amasosha omzimba asuke eselungile. Imithi yokugoma ivimbele izigidi zokufa emhlabeni jikelele - imvukuzane iyodwa esetshenziselwa ukubulala izingane eziyizigidi ezingu-2.6 ngonyaka ngaphambi komgomo.

Uhlelo lwe-SA luqala ngesikhathi sokuzalwa futhi luqhubeka phakathi neminyaka yesikole. Namathela kukho. Ukweqiwa kwesibhamu esisodwa akuziqedi ezinye, kodwa kushiya igebe ekuvikelekeni. Uma usalele ngemuva, ungabamba - khuluma nomtholampilo. Incwadi ethi Road to Health ilandelela wonke umthamo.

items.headline: Izifo eziningi
items.body: Uhlelo lwamahhala lwe-SA luvikela i-TB, uvendle, isimungumungwane, i-hepatitis B, i-pneumococcal, i-rotavirus, i-HPV, nokunye.

items.headline: Konke kumahhala
items.body: Yonke imithi yokugoma ohlelweni imahhala kuyo yonke imitholampilo kahulumeni. Ayikho i-medical aid, akukho ukuqokwa okudingekayo ukuze kuthathwe izithombe ezijwayelekile.

items.headline: Incwadi ethi Road to Health
items.body: Yonke ingane yaseNingizimu Afrika ithola incwadi ethi Road to Health lapho izalwa. Yilethe kukho konke ukuvakasha emtholampilo - ilandelela yonke imithi yokugoma, isisindo, kanye nengqopha-mlando.

items.headline: Isimungumungwana sibuyile
items.body: Ukwehla kwamazinga okugoma kubuyise ukubheduka kwesimungumungwane eNingizimu Afrika. Isimungumungwana singabulala, singaboni, noma sibangele ukulimala kwengqondo. Umuthi wokugoma uphephile futhi uyasebenza.

pull_quote.text: Imithi yokugoma iwukungenelela kwezempilo okubiza kakhulu emlandweni wesintu. IRandi ngalinye elichithwa ekugonyweni kwezingane longa okuningi ezindlekweni zokunakekelwa kwezempilo - nokunye okuningi ezimpilweni.

signs.heading: Uhlelo lwezingane lwaseNingizimu Afrika
signs.lede: Nakhu lapho ingane yakho ithola umgomo ngamunye. Ukuvakasha kwamaviki angu-6, amaviki angu-10, angu-14, izinyanga ezingu-9 kanye nezinyanga ezingu-18 yikona okubalulekile — ungakweqi.

items.title: Ekuzalweni
items.description: I-BCG (emelene ne-TB) kanye nepholiyo yomlomo yokuqala iyehla. Inikezwa ngaphambi kokuba umama nengane baphume ewodini lababelethayo.

items.title: 6, 10, kanye namaviki angu-14
items.description: I-Pentavalent (5-in-1: i-diphtheria, i-tetanus, i-pertussis, i-Hib, i-hepatitis B), amaconsi e-rotavirus, i-pneumococcal, uvendle. Konke ukuvakasha emtholampilo okufanayo.

items.title: Izinyanga eziyisi-9 neziyi-18
items.description: Umuthi wokugomela isimungumungwane kukho kokubili ukuvakasha, kanye nama-booster ezinyangeni eziyi-18. Ibalulekile ekuvikelekeni kwesimungumungwane — ungalokothi ukweqe lokhu.

items.title: Iminyaka yesikole
items.description: I-Tetanus kanye ne-diphtheria booster eminyakeni engu-6 ne-12. Umgomo we-HPV ebangeni lesi-5 wamantombazane (nabafana ezifundazweni eziningi) — ngohlelo lwesikole.

items.fact: Amashumi eminyaka ocwaningo olukhulu ezigidini zezingane alubonisi ukuxhumana phakathi kwemithi yokugoma kanye ne-autism. Ucwaningo lwangempela lwango-1998 lwatholakala luwumgunyathi futhi lwahoxiswa. Umbhali ulahlekelwe ilayisense yakhe yezokwelapha.

items.myth: Ukutheleleka kwemvelo kunikeza ukuzivikela okungcono kunemithi yokugoma.
items.fact: Ukutheleleka kwemvelo kwesinye isikhathi kunikeza ukungatheleleki okunamandla - kepha ngezindleko zesifo ngokwaso. Isimungumungwana singabulala noma sibangele ukulimala kwengqondo. Uvendle ungakhubaza. Imithi yokugoma inikeza ukuzivikela ngaphandle kwengozi.

items.myth: Imithi yokugoma eminingi esondelene kakhulu ingaphezu kwamandla omzimba.
items.fact: Amasosha omzimba omntwana alawula izinkulungwane zamagciwane amasha nsuku zonke ngenxa yokuphefumula yedwa. Amaprotheni ambalwa emgomeni ayiconsi olwandle. Uhlelo lubekwe isikhathi ukuze luvikeleke eminyakeni esengozini kakhulu.

items.myth: Uma wonke umuntu egonyiwe, ingane yami ayiwudingi.
items.fact: Ukugonywa komhlambi kusebenza kuphela lapho abantu abaningi begonyiwe. Njengoba amazinga okugoma ehla, izifo ziyabuya - njengoba sibona ngesimungumungwane eNingizimu Afrika. Ungabi yigebe.

prevention.heading: Ukuthola nokulandelela imithi yokugoma
prevention.lede: Imithi yokugoma isebenza kangcono uma inikezwe ngesikhathi nangendlela efanele. Uhlelo lwasemtholampilo lukwenza kube lula uma uletha incwadi.

items.title: Gcina incwadi ethi Road to Health
items.description: Konke ukuvakasha emtholampilo kuya kule ncwadi. Yipasipoti yengane yakho yezokwelapha yeminyaka yokuqala eyi-6. Kugcine kuphephile futhi ulethe ngaso sonke isikhathi.

items.title: Namathela ohlelweni
items.description: Ukugonywa ngesikhathi kuvikela eminyakeni esengozini kakhulu. Uma weqiwe umthamo, umtholampilo uyakubamba — ungalindi unyaka ozayo.

items.title: Ukusabela okuthambile kuvamile
items.description: Ukushisa okuncane, ububomvu, noma ukuxokozela osukwini noma ezimbili ngemva kokugoma kuvamile. IParacetamol iyasiza. Ukusabela okunamandla kuyivelakancane kakhulu — hamba emtholampilo uma ukhathazekile.

items.title: Imithi yokugoma yokubamba nokuhamba
items.description: Uma ingane yakho yeqiwe ukuthwebula izithombe noma uya phesheya, buza umtholampilo mayelana nezinhlelo zokuyifica kanye nemigomo yokuvakasha. Imithamo eminingi egejiwe inganikezwa kamuva.

items.title: Bheka incwadi ethi Road to Health
items.description: Vula ikhasi lokugoma. Bona ukuthi iziphi izithombe ingane yakho ezitholile nokuthi yiziphi okufanele zithathwe. Uma ungenayo incwadi, buza emtholampilo - bazokukhipha.

items.title: Uma ingane yakho idlulelwe yisikhathi - hamba manje
items.description: Hamba kunoma yimuphi umtholampilo nencwadi. Imithi yokugoma eminingi egejiwe inganikezwa ngosuku olufanayo. Akukho ukwahlulela, azikho izindleko ezengeziwe.

items.title: Uma ulahlekelwe incwadi
items.description: Imitholampilo eminingi inamarekhodi kagesi futhi ngokuvamile ingabheka lokho okunikeziwe. Izincwadi ezishintshwayo zimahhala.

items.title: Uma ingane yakho yaba nokusabela ngaphambilini
items.description: Tshela umtholampilo. Ukusabela okudlule okuningi akuvimbi imithamo yesikhathi esizayo - ezinye izindlela noma izinyathelo zokuphepha ziyatholakala.

items.title: Uma indodakazi yakho ifunda iBanga lesi-5
items.description: Qiniseka ukuthi uthola umuthi wokugomela i-HPV wamahhala ngohlelo lwesikole. Imithamo emibili, ngokwehlukana kwezinyanga eziyisithupha. Ivimbela iningi lomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Uhlelo lokugoma lwe-SA lungenye yezingxenye ezifinyeleleka kakhulu ohlelweni lwezempilo. Vele uphathe ingane yakho kanye nencwadi ethi Road to Health.
